chunks: And showed him the two highways

key_terms.ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ: the two highways (of good and evil)

ai.seo_question: What are the two highways mentioned in Surah Al-Balad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as God guiding humanity to the 'two paths' of ease (dunya/vice) and hardship (akhira/virtue), highlighting the divine gift of free will (ikhtiyar). The 'easy path' refers to the effortless descent into sin, while the 'difficult path' requires conscious effort and struggle (jihad al-nafs) to attain spiritual elevation. This duality underscores the human capacity to choose between worldly comfort and eternal reward, a core theme in Shi'i theological discussions on moral responsibility.
